title: Shoes at the entrance

turns.speaker: speaker
turns.text: 玄関に靴がたくさんあります。小さい赤い靴は弟のです。大きい白い靴は私のです。
turns.translation: There are lots of shoes at the entrance. The small red ones are my younger brother's. The large white ones are mine.

turns.speaker: speaker
turns.text: 弟の靴は昨日洗いました。でも、私の靴はまだ汚いです。明日、洗います。
turns.translation: I washed my younger brother's shoes yesterday. But my shoes are still dirty. I'll wash them tomorrow.

turns.speaker: speaker
turns.text: 今日は玄関を掃除します。まず靴を箱に入れてから、床を拭きます。箱は階段の下にあります。
turns.translation: Today I'll clean the entrance. First, I'll put the shoes in a box, then wipe the floor. The box is under the stairs.
